I've replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

The number comes from Dana's own messages in #north-team on 2025-08-20. She first posted 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180." She's a member of that channel, so she can see this herself. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.

I couldn't find the signed amendment in any files I can see, so I told her June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants the contract itself to back up the deck. I also pointed out that the QFL renewal was signed on 2026-03-20, so the current seat count may be different from the amendment's. I don't know whether it changed.
